name: Styled Rogue
category: Everyman Gaming, LLC – Rogue Talents, Advanced
body:
Prerequisite(s): Advanced talents

Benefit(s): A rogue that selects this talent gains one style strike, as the ninja class feature. A rogue can select this talent one additional time for every 4 levels beyond 10th that she possesses, to a maximum of three times at 18th level. A character with the style strike class feature cannot select this advanced rogue talent.
